assessment.assessment_title: RHEL 9 /etc/group file must have mode 0644 or less permissive to prevent unauthorized access.
assessment.evidence_guidance: Retain the completed source OCIL evidence and reviewer notes.
assessment.procedure:
Manual alternative preserved from the original OCIL check. Follow the source procedure; this Assessment does not execute OCIL.

Verify that the "/etc/group" file has mode "0644" or less permissive with the following command:

$ sudo stat -c "%a %n" /etc/group

644 /etc/group

If a value of "0644" or less permissive is not returned, this is a finding.
